Done. MCP servers from `session/new` (stdio and streamable-HTTP) now start in parallel at session creation — failures are skipped with a stderr line while the rest work — and their tools appear to Muse as `mcp__<server>__<tool>` in the intro and the tool registry. `tool_schema`, `list_skills`, and `read_skill` are new local tools; skill dirs come from `MUSE_SKILL_DIRS` or the documented defaults. Servers close on `session/close` and process exit; `initialize` now advertises `mcpCapabilities {http: true, sse: false}`.

Changed paths:
- `bridge/acp-mcp.mjs` (new: stdio + HTTP MCP clients, tool index, call/schema helpers)
- `bridge/acp-skills.mjs` (new: skill dir scan, front-matter parse, list/read)
- `bridge/acp-tools.mjs` (tool_schema/list_skills/read_skill dispatch, `mcp__` routing, intro lists MCP names under an 8 KB budget)
- `bin/muse-acp.mjs` (server startup on session/new, mcpCapabilities, cleanup hooks, ctx wiring)
- `tests/acp-mcp.test.mjs`, `tests/acp-skills.test.mjs`, `tests/fixtures/fake-mcp.mjs` (new)

Verification: `node /tmp/muse-acp-mcp/check.mjs "$PWD"` → OK; `node --test tests/acp-mcp.test.mjs tests/acp-skills.test.mjs tests/acp-tools.test.mjs tests/acp.test.mjs` → 19/19 pass (full suite 92/92).

```plan-fact
  {"item":3,"status":"done","evidence":["cmd:node --test tests/acp-mcp.test.mjs tests/acp-skills.test.mjs tests/acp-tools.test.mjs tests/acp.test.mjs"]}
]
```

APPROACH: each MCP server gets a tiny client exposing `{tools, call, close}` — stdio over newline JSON-RPC with a per-request pending map and 15s start timeout, HTTP over streamable-HTTP POST accepting both `application/json` and SSE `data:` frames and echoing `mcp-session-id`. Server specs stay in memory only (never persisted to sessions.json) so MCP env values can't leak to disk; the env is merged into the child env and never written to logs or Muse messages — covered by a test asserting a sentinel secret never reaches the sent log.

LESSON: `isError` on `tools/call` results is a tool-level failure, not a transport error — it must map to `TOOL RESULT (error)` rather than ok, or Muse can't tell a failed call from a successful one.

- In verification scripts and tests that create temp dirs, use /tmp explicitly (mktemp -d /tmp/x.XXXXXX, or TMPDIR=/tmp): the writer sandbox denies mkdtemp in the system TMPDIR under /var/folders. Keep PM-written check scripts in /tmp/<name>/ (the guard blocks .mjs under .agents/).
- In a folder without git (live-folder mode), never put a task's expected_outputs or owns_paths under .bb/ (chat folders): the live snapshot skips .bb, so a file written there is never counted as produced and the task blocks as missing expected_outputs. Put task deliverables in a project folder such as docs/ or reports/.
